text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
—Sirius! Stop picking fights with the 
Prez!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Huh? What are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Just a little while ago, you guys were 
talking about something, right?! Sparks 
were practically flying between you two! 
And the Prez had this scary look on her 
face—"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
......*sigh* Nothing but troublesome folks 
around that guy, huh.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Just take this, suck on it, and shut up.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "Oh, candy? Wow, thank you!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
—No, wait! Jeez, stop treating me like a 
child!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: You like sweet things, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I do like it! Just not right now!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ………… ...You know, Sirius...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Sirius, do you hate the Prez?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Because, I mean, you're always picking 
fights with me!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Don't get the wrong idea. It's got nothing 
to do with liking or disliking.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: It's just...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Just?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...I'll tell ya once you're old enough to 
drink coffee.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, what's that about?! Besides, I can 
totally drink it!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Yes, yes.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I told you to stop treating me like a kid!
